messages:
acme-cust (ACME): Getting a 413 from /v1/rerank when we send our query + ~150 docs. Error text just says "request size exceeded" — customer-facing UX is confusing, they think it's file upload size. Any idea?

mia (support): Thanks for flagging — can you paste the minimal request body (sanitized) and the raw error? Also which model/endpoint?

acme-cust (ACME): We called /v1/rerank with body: 
```json
{
  "query": "Long user search text ~1200 chars...",
  "documents": ["doc1 long text...", "doc2 long text...", ... ~150 items]
}
```
Error: {"status":413,"message":"request size exceeded"}

mia (support): Ok, that helps. @jun can you confirm what the limit is counted against (chars vs tokens vs docs count) and the message source?

jun (eng): The rerank service enforces a combined token ceiling: tokens(query) + sum(tokens(each doc passage)). The 413 is thrown at the API gateway once request exceeds configured payload byte limit, but we currently map it to a generic "request size exceeded" message. So UX is ambiguous.

devon (sre): Repro steps I'd use: 1) run a small script that computes tokens via our tokenizer lib 2) gradually increase docs until you hit the threshold. I'll drop a quick python snippet.

jun (eng): Snippet (use internal/tokenizer or tiktoken equivalent):
```python
from tokenizer import count_tokens
query = "..."
docs = ["...", ...]
count = count_tokens(query) + sum(count_tokens(d) for d in docs)
print(count)
```
Threshold for this customer tier is 120k tokens (hosted default).

mia (support): For the customer, recommend: - limit docs per call (chunk to 20-50) - truncate or summarize long passages - send top-level query shorter if you can - consider batching calls + local prefiltering with embeddings

acme-cust (ACME): Is there a way to detect earlier client-side so we can present a friendlier message instead of 413?

jun (eng): Yes — best practice: compute token budget client-side and refuse call with a clear error like "request exceeds rerank token budget: X > 120000 tokens. Try chunking or summarizing docs." We'll add an internal ticket to change gateway mapping.

devon (sre): Filed infra ticket RN-983: make 413 map to structured error "rerank_input_token_limit_exceeded" with fields: allowed_tokens, actual_tokens. Also adding short doc blurb for support responses.

mia (support): I'll send ACME a short KB and a sample client-side token check + chunking pseudocode, and ask for a small repro payload if issue persists. :thumbsup:

acme-cust (ACME): Thanks — will try chunking, will post repro if still failing. Appreciated!
